about: The Workbench icons of The Powder Toy's drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is upstream's resources/generated_icons/icon_exe_48.png. ThePowderToy-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, ThePowderToy.info beside the drawer; it has its own name here so as not to meet the program's ThePowderToy.info. ReadMe.info is also copied for the licence.
